assets.title: Invite an owner to share an experience
assets.description: For someone whose emergency or specialist-care decision was affected by cost, insurance or payment arrangements.
assets.alt_text: The Waiting Room Stories Project graphic with Chilli in a flower hat and the words Share your emergency vet care story.
assets.caption:
Did cost, insurance or payment arrangements affect emergency or specialist veterinary care for your animal? Waiting Room Stories is collecting experiences to inform practical reform, starting in the UK. US and other international experiences are welcome too. This is research, not an emergency funding service.

Read more and share your experience: https://waitingroom.kingchillithepug.com/share.html

#WaitingRoomStories #KingChilliThePug

assets.title: Explain the UK-first plan
assets.description: For introducing the project’s purpose and proposed next steps.
assets.alt_text: The Waiting Room Stories Project graphic with Chilli in a flower hat and text about emergency and specialist vet care being out of reach.
assets.caption:
Chilli had a community that could hear him. Most animals do not. Waiting Room Stories is starting with UK research on emergency payment explanations, insurance, referrals and support routes, with separate US work to follow.

Read the plan: https://waitingroom.kingchillithepug.com/what-needs-to-change.html

#WaitingRoomStories #KingChilliThePug
